_meta.changed: 1.1->1.2 (2026-07-29): ReceivedFunds registered per DL Q8. Added `grain` and `state` to every row. GRAIN is the field this schema was missing - every contradiction found in the 07-29 audit was a grain disagreement (is one row a payment, or an application of a payment?). The Documentation Standard has demanded a grain line since June and not one page carried it. `state` replaces the looser `status` vocabulary with the three-way golden/built/superseded used across this app.

stateValues.built: verified in the file on a named date

tables.name: GLOBAL_USE_VARIABLES
tables.grain: one record, ever - app state and current selection

tables.name: PropertySUMMARIES
tables.grain: one piece of real collateral. NOT a deal, NOT a loan

tables.name: Loans
tables.grain: one note with its own terms. The financial parent; a property can have several

tables.name: ExpectedTransactions
tables.grain: one thing the borrower OWES, on a date. A promise

tables.name: ReceivedFunds
tables.grain: one real-world cash event - what the BANK saw. Never split
tables.note: THE TENTH TABLE, approved DL Q8 2026-07-29. Also the transaction parent for the FMP19 Revert Record pattern: build it BEFORE the txn_* wrapper or rollback can only revert half of a multi-loan write.

tables.name: AccountTransactions
tables.grain: one line on a borrower-facing statement. A PROJECTION for output, not a cash ledger
tables.note: Needs fkReceivedFunds + fkLoan. The lean-purpose contract was correct all along; it was the layer ABOVE it that was missing.

tables.name: PaymentApplications
tables.grain: one act of assigning $X of a receipt to one owed item. Join facts only - never copy parent metadata

tables.name: Payoffs
tables.grain: one quote that was SENT to a human. Frozen, never recomputed

tables.name: PaymentInstructions
tables.grain: one reusable 'how to pay us' block. Row-based, never a global

tables.name: Standard_Transactions
tables.grain: one KIND of money movement. Taxonomy, not a glorified value list
tables.note: OPEN: `Payment Received` exists to paper over the missing receipt table. Once ReceivedFunds lands it is a double-count risk - retire it or justify it.

tables.name: Documents
tables.grain: one logical document (versions live in DocumentVersions)

notInStack.name: PropertyExpectations
notInStack.note: EXISTS in the live file with ~14 calc fields (calcNextMaturation, calcPerDiem, calcMortgageBalance, expROI) but is NOT in the canonical stack. Likely absorbed into Loans calcs. Unconfirmed - do not delete, do not build against it.
